QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] A Subconscious Harvest
QuestInfo.0: What will it take to free the people from the nightmare? Consult with #bGrendel the Really Old#k in #bEllinia Magic Library#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Grendel needs to study the subconscious realm to learn more about the dream's creator. 

Obtain 8 #bSlumbering Fragments#k from Twilight Perion monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Grendel the Slumbering Fragments. He will now fuse the Slumbering Fragments to form a Piece of Memory.

0.msg: #b(Go to Twilight Perion and hunt monsters to collect #e8 Slumbering Fragments#n.)#k

1.msg: Excellent. Let me know when you've collected all the #bSlumbering Fragments#k.

0.msg: Are you busy? I suppose it's just a dream, so take your time.

0.0: Dreams are merely a projection of one's subconscious mind. For instance, say you were scared by a monstrous bat when you were young, then you saw a bat today. Tonight, you might dream of a bat as your mind relived the long-past trauma.
0.1: Now, let's think about the Gate to the Future. If that is a dream world, wouldn't it stand to reason that it was part of someone's subconscious? There must be some clues to the owner's identity!
0.2: I'd like you to re-enter Twilight Perion and bring back #b8 Slumbering Fragments#k this time.

yes.0: There they are. Now, I will fuse the Slumbering Fragments to form a Piece of Memory.

item.0: Collect #b8 Slumbering Fragments#k from monsters near Twilight Perion.
